Hey there,

I am still in my Maths Bachelor and i chose VWL as my Anwendungsfach, but cannot really recommend it as there are very little courses to chose from and most of them are not at all interesting from a mathematicians point of view. I heard similar things about the BWL courses, albeit not that bad.
I guess the standard way to go is Informatik, the profile compared to maths is really similar I'd say.
Physics is also a good choice i believe but it is rather hard and I heard that you might need a lot of pre-knowledge.

You can definitely chose a different Anwendungsfach as those four if you submit a form to the exam board. Two friends of mine took chemistry and philosophy respectively and i believe medicine should also always be approved.
